entries.name: Royal Burial Chamber
entries.description: A grand vaulted hall lined with towering funerary pillars.
entries.feature: A raised gilded bier draped in ceremonial silks.
entries.possible_reward: Ancient dynastic signet and golden burial mask.
entries.possible_encounter: Mummified royal guardians awakening from stasis.
entries.possible_exit: Stairs descending into the deeper necropolis vault.

entries.name: Hall of the Honored Dead
entries.description: Colonnades of engraved marble tablets honor legendary warriors.
entries.feature: A glowing spectral brazier burning with blue flame.
entries.possible_reward: An ancestral weapon hung above the memorial dais.
entries.possible_encounter: Restless warrior phantoms testing the party's courage.
entries.possible_exit: A heavy stone archway leading down to the lower tier.

entries.name: Sealed Necropolis
entries.description: An underground miniature city of mausoleums carved into cavern walls.
entries.feature: A central obelisk humming with warding resonance.
entries.possible_reward: Jeweled urns holding preserved sacred unguents.
entries.possible_encounter: A necro-priest and attendant ghouls.
entries.possible_exit: A cracked fissure opening onto the next descent.

entries.name: Chamber of the First Ancestor
entries.description: The primordial heart of the catacomb, carved from black basalt.
entries.feature: A monolithic sarcophagus covered in proto-runes.
entries.possible_reward: A primordial focus talisman.
entries.possible_encounter: The tomb's ancient founding entity.
entries.possible_exit: A subterranean spiraling shaft.

entries.name: Grand Mausoleum
entries.description: An ornate domed chamber echoing with ambient wind from unseen shafts.
entries.feature: Statues of weeping mourners ringing an elevated tomb.
entries.possible_reward: A chest of platinum funeral coins and tribute.
entries.possible_encounter: A tomb stalker coiled among the rafters.
entries.possible_exit: A stone stair hidden behind a kneeling effigy.

entries.name: Forgotten King's Tomb
entries.description: A secluded subterranean sanctuary untouched for centuries.
entries.feature: An enthroned skeleton clad in tarnished silver armor.
entries.possible_reward: The ancient monarch's crown and sceptre.
entries.possible_encounter: The shade of the fallen king.
entries.possible_exit: A counterweighted floor slab opening downward.

entries.name: Commander's Hall
entries.description: A fortified inner office flanked by banners and iron battle shields.
entries.feature: A heavy oak tactical war table scattered with fortress blueprints.
entries.possible_reward: Fortress treasury keys and commanding officer's blade.
entries.possible_encounter: The garrison commander and elite bodyguards.
entries.possible_exit: A reinforced iron trapdoor descending to the lower redoubt.

entries.name: War Room
entries.description: A strategic chamber dominated by relief maps and planning sand tables.
entries.feature: A brass wall map detailing subterranean siege tunnels.
entries.possible_reward: Secret campaign journals and signet seal.
entries.possible_encounter: Tactician officers or vigilant sentries.
entries.possible_exit: A secret passage behind a weapon rack.

entries.name: Throne Hall
entries.description: An imposing assembly chamber with a massive stone dais and iron seat.
entries.feature: An iron throne overlooking tiered spectator galleries.
entries.possible_reward: Ceremonial regalia and a coffer of coin.
entries.possible_encounter: The usurper warlord holding court.
entries.possible_exit: A stone tunnel leading beneath the dais.

entries.name: Inner Keep
entries.description: The central fortress citadel, engineered to withstand prolonged siege.
entries.feature: Portcullis winches and reinforced arrow loops.
entries.possible_reward: Masterwork siege armor and armory requisitions.
entries.possible_encounter: Garrison champions making a desperate stand.
entries.possible_exit: A spiral stair well leading down to the dungeons.

entries.name: Treasury
entries.description: A vault reinforced with banded iron doors and double lockways.
entries.feature: Vault lock mechanisms and stacked tribute strongboxes.
entries.possible_reward: The collected payroll of the entire fortress.
entries.possible_encounter: An iron automaton guardian or vault warden.
entries.possible_exit: A smuggling escape shaft beneath floor tiles.

entries.name: Dungeon Master's Chamber
entries.description: A grim subterranean sanctum controlling the fortress cells.
entries.feature: A rack of iron keys and surveillance speaking tubes.
entries.possible_reward: Universal cell key and enchanted warden's baton.
entries.possible_encounter: The Chief Inquisitor or Master Gaoler.
entries.possible_exit: Stairs descending into the forgotten deep cells.

entries.name: [Placeholder] Heart of the Cavern
entries.description: A colossal hollow where massive stalactites hang over a luminous subterranean lake.
entries.feature: Bioluminescent moss illuminating crystal formations.
entries.possible_reward: Raw gemstone cluster and ancient fossil relic.
entries.possible_encounter: An apex cavern beast in its lair.
entries.possible_exit: A deep chasm with a natural descending ledge.

entries.name: [Placeholder] Crystal Geode Sanctum
entries.description: The cavern walls open into a spherical geode lined with giant violet crystals.
entries.feature: Resonant crystals humming when touched.
entries.possible_reward: Pristine resonating crystals.
entries.possible_encounter: Crystalline elementals.
entries.possible_exit: A fissure leading deeper underground.

entries.name: [Placeholder] Abyssal Rift Chamber
entries.description: A shelf of stone overlooking an abyss where hot sulfurous vents breathe.
entries.feature: A natural stone arch bridging the yawning chasm.
entries.possible_reward: Rare alchemical minerals along the thermal vents.
entries.possible_encounter: Chasm flyers or subterranean ambushers.
entries.possible_exit: A steep descending tunnel carved by water.

entries.name: [Placeholder] Sanctum Sanctorum
entries.description: A soaring chamber lit by eternal unburning candles around a sacred dais.
entries.feature: A towering idol holding an offering chalice.
entries.possible_reward: A consecrated holy relic and blessed incense.
entries.possible_encounter: The Temple Hierophant and zealot initiates.
entries.possible_exit: A staircase descending beneath the altar.

entries.name: [Placeholder] The Inner Reliquary
entries.description: Warded glass cases and gilded plinths house sacred fragments of the faith.
entries.feature: An illuminated central vault glowing with soft warmth.
entries.possible_reward: An ancient religious artifact.
entries.possible_encounter: A celestial or divine guardian construct.
entries.possible_exit: A stone corridor descending to the crypts below.

entries.name: [Placeholder] High Altar of the Forgotten
entries.description: A secluded shrine hidden behind faded velvet tapestries and secret lintels.
entries.feature: A stone font filled with shimmering sacred oil.
entries.possible_reward: Ancient ritual scrolls and prayer beads.
entries.possible_encounter: A fanatical sect performing a dark rite.
entries.possible_exit: A secret descending door behind the font.

entries.name: [Placeholder] Grand Throne of the Lost City
entries.description: A shattered marble throne sits beneath a collapsed ceiling open to the subterranean gloom.
entries.feature: A cracked imperial dais still bearing ancient sigils.
entries.possible_reward: A lost emperor's signet and jewel-encrusted chalice.
entries.possible_encounter: A warlord among the ruins or scavenging horrors.
entries.possible_exit: A broken tunnel descending beneath the throne.

entries.name: [Placeholder] Forgotten Imperial Archive
entries.description: Stone book stacks survive where parchment has turned to dust, holding stone tablets.
entries.feature: A locked bronze scholar's chest.
entries.possible_reward: Ancient maps and historical treatises.
entries.possible_encounter: Constructs maintaining the ruins or animated armor.
entries.possible_exit: A spiral stone staircase leading down.

entries.name: [Placeholder] The Ruined Arcane Core
entries.description: A circular room dominated by a cracked crystal sphere that sparks with residual energy.
entries.feature: Arcane conduits leaking faint magical light.
entries.possible_reward: Arcane power crystals and enchanted salvage.
entries.possible_encounter: An unstable magical entity.
entries.possible_exit: A scorched hole in the floor leading down.

entries.name: [Placeholder] The Master Sluice
entries.description: A massive junction of iron floodgates and churning water wheels controlling city drainage.
entries.feature: A control platform with giant iron valve wheels.
entries.possible_reward: Smuggler's cache chained beneath the walkway.
entries.possible_encounter: A giant subterranean predator or sewer king.
entries.possible_exit: A drained outflow conduit leading downward.

entries.name: [Placeholder] Sunken Smuggler's Haven
entries.description: A dry brick vault fitted with rope bridges, hammocks, and contraband crates.
entries.feature: A makeshift tavern bar and illicit supply cache.
entries.possible_reward: Stashed stolen loot and smuggler passkeys.
entries.possible_encounter: Hostile outlaw crew.
entries.possible_exit: A trapdoor leading to ancient forgotten sewers below.

entries.name: [Placeholder] Forgotten Royal Aqueduct
entries.description: Arched stone viaducts of masterwork masonry far predating the newer city sewers.
entries.feature: A carved marble intake carved with regal crests.
entries.possible_reward: Ancient ornamental masonry pieces and dropped valuables.
entries.possible_encounter: An aquatic mutant or ooze colony.
entries.possible_exit: An aqueduct branch descending into deeper strata.
